Game Overview

In 3 Minutes to Escape, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a mazelike space under pressure in 3 Minutes to Escape. Dash and jump through obstacle-laden levels, amass coins, and strike the red button to flee in record time. Are you clever enough to beat the ticking countdown and secure your freedom? Test your quick-thinking prowess now!
